bio.text: Ben Allen represents California's 24th Senate District, covering the Westside, Hollywood, South Bay and Santa Monica Mountains communities of Los Angeles County; he was first elected in 2014 and is serving his third term.
Before the Senate, he served as president of the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education, lectured at UCLA Law School, and worked as an attorney.

He grew up in the 24th Senate District and graduated from Santa Monica High School in 1996. He holds a bachelor's degree in history from Harvard University, a master's degree in Latin American studies from the University of Cambridge, and a law degree from UC Berkeley.
